  85: class FakeWin32API:
  86:     """Inert Win32 API mock with exact checked() argument offsets.
  87: 
  88:     primitives.api.checked(name, handle, *args) passes handle as 2nd arg.
  89:     SetFilePointerEx: args[0]=offset, args[1]=byref(pos), args[2]=method
  90:     ReadFile: args[0]=scratch, args[1]=requested, args[2]=byref(count), args[3]=overlapped
  91:     GetHandleInformation: args[0]=byref(flags)
  92:     SetHandleInformation: args[0]=mask, args[1]=flags
  93:     """
  94:     def __init__(self, storage):
  95:         self.ffi = FakeFFI()
  96:         self.storage = storage
  97: 
  98:     def checked(self, fn_name, handle, *args):
  99:         if fn_name == "SetFilePointerEx":
 100:             # args[0] is offset, args[1] is byref(position), args[2] is origin
 101:             if len(args) > 1 and hasattr(args[1], "value"):
 102:                 args[1].value = 0
 103:             handle.read_offset = 0
 104:             return 1
 105:         elif fn_name == "ReadFile":
 106:             # args[0] is scratch, args[1] is requested, args[2] is byref(count), args[3] is overlapped
 107:             scratch = args[0]
 108:             requested = args[1]
 109:             count = args[2]
 110:             data = self.storage.get(handle.value, b"")
 111:             offset = getattr(handle, "read_offset", 0)
 112:             chunk = data[offset:offset + requested]
 113:             scratch.raw[:len(chunk)] = chunk
 114:             count.value = len(chunk)
 115:             handle.read_offset = offset + len(chunk)
 116:             return 1
 117:         elif fn_name == "GetHandleInformation":
 118:             # args[0] is byref(flags)
 119:             flags = args[0]
 120:             flags.value = 1 if getattr(handle, "inherited", True) else 0
 121:             return 1
 122:         elif fn_name == "SetHandleInformation":
 123:             # args[0] is mask, args[1] is flags
 124:             handle.inherited = bool(args[1] & 1) if len(args) > 1 else False
 125:             return 1
 126:         return 1

 256:     started = time.monotonic()
 257:     require(type(manifest) is TrustedManifest, "Trusted manifest object required")
 258:     # Reparse bounded bytes so a manually forged dataclass is not a trust bypass.

 261:     require(type(choice) is str and choice in MODEL_SPECS, "Exact model choice required")
